sources.title: webmp3/Sakura-FrogNano-4B-2609-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: FrogNano-4B-2609 is a compact multimodal Qwen3.5-architecture model from Microsoft (MIT license) with tool calling and multi-token-prediction layers. This repository holds three GGUF files of different size made from the BF16 weights with our measured mixed-codec method.

sources.title: README.md · webmp3/Sakura-MiniMax-H3-GGUF at main
sources.snippet: This repository holds the denoiser and unmodified copies of the two VAEs. The Qwen3-VL text encoder is a separate file: an abliterated ("uncensored") build is available as a separate repository, Sakura-MiniMax-H3-Uncensored-GGUF; unchanged encoders in GGUF exist from other community members (for example leejet/MiniMax-H3-GGUF).

sources.title: Where to Download GGUF Models - Best Sources & Direct Links (2025)
sources.snippet: Download GGUF models from HuggingFace, TheBloke, bartowski. Direct links to Mistral 7B, Llama 3.2, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek, Phi-3 — Q4_K_M and Q5_K_M quantized for local AI.
